python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# All weekly average discount rates for 91-day bills issued in September across 1953-1955
rates_1953 = [1.961, 1.953, 1.957, 1.634]
rates_1954 = [1.022, 1.016, 1.024, 0.986, 0.984]
rates_1955 = [2.088, 2.135, 2.104, 1.981, 2.122]

all_rates = rates_1953 + rates_1954 + rates_1955

print("All rates:", all_rates)
print("Count:", len(all_rates))
print("Years breakdown: 1953:", len(rates_1953), ", 1954:", len(rates_1954), ", 1955:", len(rates_1955))

# Calculate geometric mean
# Geometric mean = (product of all rates)^(1/n)
product = 1.0
for r in all_rates:
    product *= r

print(f"\nProduct of all rates: {product}")

geometric_mean = product ** (1.0 / len(all_rates))
print(f"Geometric mean: {geometric_mean}")

# Round to nearest thousandths (3 decimal places)
rounded = round(geometric_mean, 3)
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {rounded}")

# Verify by calculating ln-based method as well
ln_sum = sum(math.log(r) for r in all_rates)
geo_ln = math.exp(ln_sum / len(all_rates))
print(f"\nVerification via log method: {geo_ln}")
print(f"Verification rounded: {round(geo_ln, 3)}")
EOF
